messages:
sam_customer: Hey team — our trial credits disappeared this morning. Account rwd_corp_81. We had ~120 credits left yesterday; I ran a few test calls and now balance shows 0. No billing email. Can this be reinstated? :worried:
alex_cs: Sorry about that, Sam. Can you DM me the org ID and the last 4 of the CC? I'll check logs and escalate if it's an auto-apply failure.
jordan_support: Looping in billing bot — @billing-bot can you pull the usage & promo history for rwd_corp_81? Also what endpoint were you hitting?
billing-bot: Automated audit for org=rwd_corp_81
- promo_applied: false
- promo_code_history: []
- trial_start: 2026-02-05
- trial_end: 2026-03-06
- total_tokens_consumed: 1,923,450
- last_api_call: 2026-03-06T08:12:11Z
Note: No promo redemption found.
sam_customer: We definitely had a promo code from onboarding email — code was WELCOME_2026. I used the web console to apply it last week; screenshot attached.
alex_cs: Thanks. Can you paste the cmd you used or the web flow steps? Also can you run:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/credits
```
and share the response (redact keys)?
jordan_support: If the promo didn't actually attach, it may be a frontend race condition. We'll need request IDs from the time you applied. Sam, do you have the browser console logs or a `network` HAR for that apply event?
sam_customer: I have a screenshot and the network HAR (uploading now). The apply returned 200 and "success" but credits didn't increment. No error shown.
maya_ops: Escalating to finance for manual reinstatement — @finance_lead please review. Also tagging eng-frontend for possible race condition.
finance_lead: On it. Can you confirm the desired adjustment? Per policy we can reinstate up to the original trial amount for first-time issues. If you show proof of attempted apply, we can grant a one-time 60-day extension.
sam_customer: Requesting: reinstate 150 credits + extend expiry 60 days. Would help avoid production hit.
alex_cs: Case opened RWD-4521. I've attached the HAR and screenshot. Jordan, can you include the server logs around 2026-03-06T08:12Z — look for event `promo_apply` and `billing_adjust`.
jordan_support: Found promo_apply events for that session: promo code accepted in frontend but backend returned `202 Accepted` with no finalization — looks like webhook to billing failed (timeout). We'll retry and if missing, we'll create a manual billing_adjust entry.
billing-bot: Billing adjustment pending: +150 credits for org=rwd_corp_81, pending approval by finance.
finance_lead: Approved. Manually applying +150 credits and setting expiry to 60 days from today (2026-05-05). Note: we document the customer's proof and log mismatch for audit.
alex_cs: Done — Sam, you should see +150 credits in the console within a few minutes. Also added note: Case RWD-4521. We'll follow up if this recurs.
sam_customer: I see them, thanks!! :tada: Really appreciate the quick help.
alex_cs: Sorry again for the disruption. We'll keep monitoring. If you can share steps that reproduce reliably we'll prioritize a bugfix in eng-frontend.
sam_customer: Will do — I can try to reproduce this afternoon and ping here.
jordan_support: Closing loop for now. Marking thread resolved but leaving case open until 2 weeks of clean events.
